description: Can a v=0 block (two consecutive odd steps) occur inside the q-Collatz domain-stable cone D_inf? Searches the backward-orbit tree of the attractor using two exact criteria: forward P(-1)=-1 & P'(-1)=-2, backward P(w)=-w & P'(w)=2 at a primitive cube root of unity. Exact Laurent and Z[w] arithmetic. Exploratory research probe (NOT canonical production).
